## Background

There are sex-based differences in parental investment in Adelie penguins[@beaulieu2009].

There are sex-based differences in growth rate and diets in Adelie penguins [@sex-base].

Foraging frequency in Adelie penguins causes differences in body mass [@lescroël2021].
